from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def _components(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            out.append((color, cells))
    return out

def _shape(cells):
    minr = min(r for r,c in cells)
    minc = min(c for r,c in cells)
    return frozenset((r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cells)

def transform(grid):
    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    objects = _components(grid)
    for color, cells in objects:
        if color != 1:
            continue
        shape = _shape(cells)
        matches = [(other_color, other_cells) for other_color, other_cells in objects
                   if other_color != 1 and _shape(other_cells) == shape]
        if not matches:
            continue
        # When several colored examples have the same shape, use the nearest one.
        target, _ = min(matches, key=lambda item: min(abs(r-y)+abs(c-x) for r,c in cells for y,x in item[1]))
        for r,c in cells:
            result[r][c] = target
    return result
'''
path=program_dir/'task-c551d00c.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
